# NimbleZero - conservative fallback configuration.
# Only the board overlay (LCD + keyboard) is loaded; HDMI and UART consoles are
# enabled so a failed LCD bring-up can still be debugged.
arm_64bit=1
kernel=Image
enable_uart=1
uart_2ndstage=1
camera_auto_detect=0
hdmi_force_hotplug=1
dtparam=i2c_arm=on
dtparam=spi=on
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
dtoverlay=cardputerzero-v5-overlay
cmdline=cmdline-safe.txt
